Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4245; the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery":--(estate of) elder(-s), presbytery.
BiblicalUsage: Presbyterion is the order of elders, the council, the presbytery. Luke gathers the elders of the people at the trial of Jesus, Paul appeals to all the estate of the elders, and Timothy is told not to neglect the gift given with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the church was never meant to rest on one man's shoulders, and the elders together carry the weight.
